limits: Exact native cockatriceC / enChicken / renderer 121484 source assignment only; no Cockatrice A controller, boss bind variant, resource rig, sibling chassis, or topology receives credit from this record.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced health from 72 to 62; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Eighteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 342 captured frames and generated videos are retained evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture drives the native Cockatrice_DeathHuge animation through an intact recoil, backward fall, and coherent prone custom-mesh corpse that remains sampled behind the loot overlay; native m_DoRagdoll remains false and this does not establish ordinary lethal behavior or later corpse lifetime.

The causal Damaged and Death impact frames are strongly occluded by the foreground hero and bright effects; recovery and the death fall remain readable, and no sampled neck gap, shoulder separation, detached wing, missing leg, tail break, floor clipping, or viewport clipping was observed.
Other native attacks, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
